independent_packet_audit.scope: Finite exact/modular implementation checks. Universal statements are Lean theorems.

claims: All-order genuine iterated derivatives of restricted dyadic series equal factorial-scaled evaluated Hasse jets
All-order Hasse jets and ordinary derivatives commute with the actual infinite Euler packet sum, with proved summability
Explicit skeleton/source derivative channels for each actual analytic packet
Every-order complete numerator packet-tail precision, explicit factorial and beta-normalization factors
Finite complete coefficient/value-slope certificate soundness for actual H_r and G_r
Every packet beyond a nonnegative integer row vanishes in value but has nonzero first analytic derivative
Actual differentiated Euler residual recurrence and exact denominator-free Wronskian critical-zero criterion
All-order derivative scaling for the actual carry-normalized G_r
Exact derivative norm 1/2 on all dyadic arguments at every positive depth with at most two binary one-bits
nonclaims: No new irregular terminal-family atlas or enlarged mathematical coverage bound
No claim that the sum of all omitted nonzero packet slopes is always nonzero
No universal Euler critical-scalar or Wronskian nonvanishing
No completion of all terminal carry-address and local Euler coefficient bridges
No general closed-disc Weierstrass preparation construction in this release
No new foundational derivative or historical-priority claim
No full Lean or mathlib bootstrap from source
failures_and_recovery: An initial streaming interface was unsupported and rejected before running a command; ordinary polled subprocess execution succeeded.
An initial development compile preceded creation of a baseline dependency output. It was rerun after the dependency was compiled.
Development import/API/coercion/typeclass/tactic/linter errors were corrected before both complete clean replays.
trust_boundary: Actual Lean compiler/kernel with pinned cached mathlib dependencies; only Classical.choice, Quot.sound and propext in the transitive axiom union.
